query:
MATCH (p:Patient)<-[:FOR_PATIENT]-(sr:SurgeryRecord)-[:PERFORMED_BY]->(d:Doctor)<-[:ASSIGNED_DOCTOR]-(ss:StaffShift)-[:ASSIGNED_NURSE]->(n1:Nurse), 
      (p)<-[:FOR_PATIENT]-(br:BedRecord)-[:ASSIGNED_NURSE]->(n2:Nurse)
WHERE n1.nurseId = n2.nurseId
RETURN DISTINCT n1.nurseId
